title: 2026 Community Wood Kiln Firings
source_quote:
2026 Community Wood Kiln Firings
Limit
9 participants
1 share per person – 12″ x 24″ x 30″
Level
Intermediate/Advanced Adults

2026 Firing Dates:
We offer openings in a rotating sequence alongside class semester releases.
Winter Classes:
February 13th-15th
April 10th-12th
Spring Classes:
May 29th-31st
Summer Classes:
August 7th – 9th
September 11th-13th
Fall Classes:
December 11th -13th
evidence_sentence: The page lists multiple 2026 wood kiln firing dates for community participants, with Rich Holck overseeing loading, firing, and unloading.
evidence_quote: The Chester Springs Studio wood kiln is a two-chamber noborigama, built in 2023 during a workshop with pottery artist and kiln builder Ted Neal. The first chamber is fired solely with wood
summary: Join a community wood firing with experienced potters at a noborigama kiln. You provide bisque-fired work in a kiln share (12″ x 24″ x 30″, one per person), work two 3-hour stoking shifts, and help load and unload. Cost is $250 non-members, $225 members. Six firings scheduled for 2026.
bring: Bisque-fired work, leather gloves, dust mask, work gloves, protective eyewear
commitment: Fri glazing 12:30pm–9:30pm, Sat loading 9:30am–2pm, Sat–Sun firing 2pm–4pm, Thu unloading 3–6pm
how_to_join: Register online via the registration link
